text: 摩根大通策略师认为，随着市场表现向更多板块扩散，科技股或人工智能相关股票下半年不太可能是市场回报的主要驱动力。由Mislav Matejka带领的团队表示，动量交易的抛售可能大部分已经结束，半导体股目前已接近超卖水平该团队在报告中写道：“由于每股收益动能依然向上，这应有助于相关股票企稳”。不过，其预计市场表现将继续向更多板块扩散，并重申，由于地缘政治局势紧张，建议投资者逢低买入。
text_en: JPMorgan strategists believe that as market performance broadens across more sectors, technology stocks or AI-related stocks are unlikely to be the main driver of market returns in the second half of the year. The team led by Mislav Matejka said the sell-off in momentum trades may be largely over, and semiconductor stocks are now near oversold levels. The team wrote in a report, 'With EPS momentum still pointing upward, this should help related stocks stabilize.' However, they expect market performance to continue broadening across sectors and reiterated a recommendation for investors to buy on dips due to geopolitical tensions.
